extDescription.message: Code Formatter – all-in-one extension offering sophisticated syntax highlighting for CSS, JSON, and JavaScript.

popupDescription.message: Formats & beautifies code with syntax highlighting

guideLead.message: Code Formatter works on its own. There are no buttons to press and nothing to select: open a code file in a browser tab and it is formatted automatically.

guideStep1Title.message: Open a code file in a tab

guideStep1Text.message: Click a link that ends in .json, .css, .js, .ts, .xml, .yaml…, open an API URL that returns JSON, or drag a file from your computer into Chrome.

guideStep2Text.message: Minified JSON, CSS and JavaScript are re-indented. Every file gets syntax highlighting, line numbers and arrows to collapse blocks.

guideStep3Text.message: At the top: switch between formatted and original, copy, download, and open the settings for theme, line numbers and word wrap. At the bottom: collapse or expand everything.

guideFilesText.message: Chrome blocks extensions from reading local files (file://) until you allow it. This is a one-time switch.

guideFilesOn.message: Access to local files is on. You are all set.

guideFilesOff.message: Access to local files is off.

guideFilesStep1.message: Click the button below to open this extension's settings.

guideFilesStep2.message: Turn on “Allow access to file URLs”.

guideFilesStep3.message: Reload the tab with your file.

guideJsonPath.message: Click any key or value: its path (for example $$.users[2].email) is shown in the bar at the bottom. Use “Copy path” to copy it.

guideJsonFold.message: Click the arrows next to the line numbers to collapse an object or array. “Collapse all” keeps the top level open so you can drill down one level at a time.

guideJsonLinks.message: Links inside the data are underlined. Hold Ctrl (⌘ on Mac) and click to open them.

guideJsonSearch.message: Press Ctrl+F (⌘+F on Mac) to search inside the file.

guideLimitsPages.message: It only works on pages that show a raw file. It does not change code shown inside normal websites, forums or online editors.

guideLimitsSettings.message: Settings you change in the toolbar or in the extension popup are remembered for all files.

guideLimitsOffline.message: Everything runs on your computer. Your code is never sent anywhere.

fileAccessOffTitle.message: Local files are not formatted yet

fileAccessOffText.message: To format files opened from your computer (file://), turn on “Allow access to file URLs” for this extension.

howToUseShort.message: There is nothing to click. Open any code file in a tab (a link ending in .json, .css, .js…, an API response, or a file from your computer) and it is formatted automatically.

fileAccessBadgeTitle.message: Local file not formatted: click for how to enable file access

guideHeroTitle.message: Open a code file. It formats itself.

aboutText.message: Formats code files you open in a tab. Read-only, runs fully in your browser.
